tactics:
induction l with
| nil => simp
| cons a l ih => cases h : f a <;> simp [List.filterMap_cons, h, ih]

induction l with
| nil => rfl
| cons a l ih => cases h : f a <;> simp_all [List.filterMap_cons]

induction l with
| nil => simp
| cons a l ih => simp only [List.filterMap_cons, List.foldrM_cons, ih]; cases f a <;> rfl
